correctness.rationale: Lucas and 2^(5^s)≡2 mod 5 factor the defining sum digitwise. The residues 1,3,3,3,1 give the stated character weights and no zero terms. For an aligned block of size 5^m, upper-digit phases cancel except for at most h indices, so the complex discrepancy from the initial block is at most 2h, including h≥5^m. Normalizing over larger aligned partitions gives the limit and single-block discrepancy from it ≤2h on the initial block; arbitrary prefixes partition into at most four aligned blocks per scale. The reconstructed no-carry/carry sums are (5,0),(2,1),(1,0),(0,1),(1,2), with complex parts cancelling. C(0)=1, C(1)=1/2 follows from the one self-reference, and the recurrence decreases remaining positive arguments. All branches are positive; after checking residues 1–4, a nonzero remainder with positive quotient gives ≤3/10, so the exact equality lags are 5^j. Repeating digit 2 gives 5^{-m}; summing the branches yields S_{m+1}=(13/5)S_m-2/5 including S_0=1. Marginals follow by the aligned-block character power sums and finite Fourier inversion. Herglotz applies by limiting finite Gram forms (fixed boundary shifts do not matter). The complete-block upper bound on the mean of |C|² tends to zero since |C|²≤C, also for intermediate cutoffs by comparison; Wiener then gives atomlessness. Powers of five certify nondecay, not pure singularity. Independent exact tests of 500 original residues, all five digit pairs, lag sums, and finite-prefix discrepancies agree; replay `python3 /workspace/audit_checks/frozen_reconstruction.py`. These finite diagnostics do not prove the limits.

value.rationale: This is an exact autocorrelation law for a canonical lattice-path counting sequence, distinct from marginal equidistribution. It gives all positive-lag signs, precisely identifies the persistent high correlations, and quantifies aggregate decay through exact power-block sums, enough to discriminate spectral point masses from Fourier nondecay. These jointly useful structural conclusions justify the specific small-prime calculation. The full residue-pair law and pure spectral continuity class remain out of scope.
